name: OpenMontage
use_label: Video production via your coding agent
one_liner: Turns a coding assistant into a full video production pipeline.

text.why: One video pulls in a different tool for planning, subtitles, dubbing and editing. openmontage moves that chain into skills and pipelines a coding assistant can drive from one place. The repository lists 12 production pipelines, over 100 tools and more than 700 skill and production-knowledge files. It is written in Python and published under AGPL-3.0, so the terms depend on how you use it.
text.take: An experiment in handing a whole video pipeline to a coding agent, notable for a free path that needs no keys.
build: An in-house line that drafts product videos automatically
A multilingual release flow that finishes subtitles and dubbing
A repeatable production run for social clips

who.situation: drafts a product explainer video quickly
makes script, narration and captions in one pass
experiments with video automation from a coding agent

start.text: Needs Python 3.10+, FFmpeg, Node.js 18+ and an AI coding assistant
Open the project in your coding assistant and describe the video

caveat: AGPL-3.0: check the terms before offering a modified version as a service
Image and video providers add per-video cost (README examples: $0.15 to $3)
It cannot run without an assistant such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex

license.scope_text: Release source if you redistribute or host it as a service.
